Dear Friends of Wutong Lane, if you are sitting on our favourite park bench today...
Then Room Nine has opened its green shutters to the neighbourhood once more!
Listen to the next line: Thirty summers ago, five friends made a Saturday promise.
What promise did my professor and the courtyard crew make back then, Qing?
To hang lanterns from the red-star balcony and share berry almond cake again!
Oh, how lovely—and is there a postscript at the bottom of the card?
Look: Watch your front-desk mail this week, because I keep my promises!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì qǐ. Placed right before the verb to mean 'together' (一起吃晚饭 'have dinner together').

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 等等，让我把平板屏幕和纸本子放一起看。
examples.trans: Wait—let me look at the tablet screen and the paper ledger side by side.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān shí. Cardinal number thirty ('three tens'); pairs directly with measure words like 三十年 ('thirty years').

examples.text: 这棵老树在院子里长了三十年。
examples.trans: This old tree has grown in the courtyard for thirty years.

examples.text: 从客栈走到地铁站只要三十分钟。
examples.trans: Walking from the inn to the metro station takes only thirty minutes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià. Used for downward motion ('go down'), location ('under'), or 'next' (下周).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 你甭纠结，他基本上不会记得你是谁。
examples.trans: Do not agonise over it — he basically will not remember who you are.

examples.text: 你甭纠结，他基本上不会记得你是谁。
examples.trans: Do not agonise over it — he basically will not remember who you are.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎng. Used instead of 二 when counting things with a measure word (两个, 两把, 两间).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǔ. Cardinal number 9.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 九分钟！牛奶、鸡蛋和苹果都买来了！
examples.trans: Nine minutes! The milk, eggs, and apples are all here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: èr. Used in counting, ordinals (第二), room numbers, and multi-digit numbers (二十); use 两 before measure words.

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ. Cardinal number 5.

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǔ yuè. Fifth month of the year ('month five').

examples.text: 五月的成都院子里到处都是花香。
examples.trans: In May, courtyards in Chengdu are filled with the scent of flowers everywhere.

examples.text: 这张旧照片是五月的一个晴天拍的。
examples.trans: This old photo was taken on a sunny day in May.

meanings.note: Adjective qīn'ài ('dear').

examples.text: 亲爱的同事们，大家辛苦了。
examples.trans: Dear colleagues, thank you all for your hard work.

examples.text: 她给亲爱的家人打了个电话。
examples.trans: She called her dear family.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shén me. Asks 'what?' on its own (什么？) or modifies a noun (什么茶 'what kind of tea').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 今天一天 ('all day today').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

meanings.note: Pinyin: cóng. Marks a starting point in space or time (从早上到晚上 'from morning to night').

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tā. Third-person singular masculine pronoun; pronounced identically to 她 and 它.

examples.text: 他没要回那个装木头小火车的箱子吗？
examples.trans: Did he not ask back for that case with the wooden train?

examples.text: 他留了纸条，请我们保管到星期五。
examples.trans: He left a note asking us to keep it until Friday.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ qián. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 以前的日子 ('days in the past').

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

examples.text: 哦？您家里人以前住在这附近吗？
examples.trans: Oh? Did your family live near here once?

related.gloss: days in the past (measure word 段)

meanings.note: Pinyin: huì. Expresses either an acquired skill (会弹钢琴) or likelihood in the future (会下雨).

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ men. Plural 'you' for addressing two or more people (including polite groups).

examples.text: 太谢谢你们两位了。
examples.trans: Thank you both so very much.

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xìn fēng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个信封 ('an envelope').

examples.text: 看，把手上贴着一个白信封。
examples.trans: Look, there is a white envelope taped onto the handle.

examples.text: 桌子上放着一个白色的信封。
examples.trans: A white envelope is lying on the table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xìn xiāng. Combines 信 ('letter/mail') + 箱 ('box/chest'); measure word: 个 (gè) or 只 (zhī).

examples.text: 刚才邮递员往门口信箱里塞了一张厚厚的外国明信片。
examples.trans: Just now the postman slipped a thick foreign postcard into the gate mailbox.

examples.text: 小晴每天早上开门时都会先检查前门的信箱。
examples.trans: Every morning when opening the gate, Qing checks the front-door mailbox first.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gōngyuán. Measure word: 个, 座.

examples.text: 周末我们去公园散步吧。
examples.trans: Let's go for a walk in the park this weekend.

examples.text: 公园里有很多小孩在玩耍。
examples.trans: There are many children playing in the park.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. Marks a next step in sequence (先提再推) or a future repetition (再见 'see you again').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.en: go out the door; head out
meanings.note: Pinyin: chū mén. Separable verb-object compound for leaving home or the inn.

examples.text: 你们守着，我出门啦！
examples.trans: Hold the fort—I am heading out the door!

examples.text: 出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
examples.trans: Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

meanings.note: Verb fēnxiǎng ('share information or joy').

examples.text: 这些数据在公司都没有分享过吧？
examples.trans: These figures have never been shared inside the firm, right?

examples.text: 谢谢你跟我分享这个好消息。
examples.trans: Thank you for sharing this good news with me.

meanings.note: Adjective lìluo ('brisk, clean and efficient').

examples.text: 这位大师兄办事真的很利落。
examples.trans: Our senior alumnus handles work very crisply.

examples.text: 林姐说话做事都特别利落。
examples.trans: Lin Jie speaks and acts with brisk efficiency.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Works as main verb ('arrive') or result complement ('succeed in reaching/perceiving', 找到, 听到).

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhì tú yuán. Combines 制图 ('make maps/charts') + occupational suffix 员 ('person/specialist'); measure word: 位 (wèi) or 名 (míng).

examples.text: 那时我是个年轻的制图员，你们阳光房的热茶救了我淋湿的地图。
examples.trans: Back then I was a young mapmaker, and your sunroom tea saved my rain-soaked maps.

examples.text: 这位细心的制图员用钢笔在厚纸上画出了整条老街。
examples.trans: This careful mapmaker drew the entire old lane on heavy paper with a fountain pen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个前面 ('a front side').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián tái. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个前台 ('a front desk').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 您刚才忘在楼下前台汤碗旁边了。
examples.trans: You left it downstairs beside the soup bowl at the front desk.

meanings.note: Small paper card for notes, gifts, or study.

examples.text: 礼物盒里放着一张小卡片。
examples.trans: Inside the gift box sits a small card.

examples.text: 他在卡片上写了几句祝福。
examples.trans: He wrote a few wishes on the card.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu. Marks an action repeating, or pairs two qualities in 又A又B ('both A and B').

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
examples.trans: Another dark-blue suitcase! Is this Teacher Song's?

meanings.en: mouth; doorway; measure word for sips/breaths
meanings.note: Pinyin: kǒu. Counts mouthfuls of food/tea, breaths of air (一口气), or family members.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 宋老师早上好！看昨晚大门口送来了什么。
examples.trans: Good morning, Teacher Song! Look what arrived at our front gate last night.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个号码 ('a number').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàng. Preposition or verb complement indicating direction of movement or orientation (歪向一边 'lean toward one side').

examples.text: 向日葵总是朝着太阳的方向生长。
examples.trans: Sunflowers always grow toward the sun.

examples.text: 小晴笑着向窗外的朋友们挥了挥手。
examples.trans: Qing smiled and waved toward her friends outside the window.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Placed at the end of any statement to turn it into a neutral yes/no question.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ba. At the end of a sentence, softens commands into friendly suggestions ('let's…') or asks for confirmation.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tīng. Focuses on the act of listening; add 见 or 到 (听见, 听到) for actually hearing.

examples.text: 老陈，你听到了吗？有人按了大门门铃！
examples.trans: Chen, did you hear that? Someone rang the front gate bell!

examples.text: 我在院子里老远就听到你们喊黄油了。
examples.trans: All the way out in the courtyard I heard you shouting about butter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ya. Gentle exclamation of surprise or realization.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 呀，这就是星期一火车上那只双胞胎箱子吗？
examples.trans: Oh, is this that twin suitcase from Monday's train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Joins nouns or pronouns ('A and B'), NEVER two whole clauses; also means 'with' (和你一样).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wā. Expresses admiration or delight.

examples.text: 哇，看这间房！大木头房梁，窗户正对着院子！
examples.trans: Wow, look at this room! Big wooden beams, and a window facing the courtyard!

examples.text: 插上老陈的铜台灯……哇，黄色灯光真暖和！
examples.trans: Plug in Chen's brass lamp... wow, how warm that yellow light is!

meanings.note: Pinyin: la. Colloquial fusion of 了 + 啊 adding cheerful energy at the end of a sentence.

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 你们守着，我出门啦！
examples.trans: Hold the fort—I am heading out the door!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xǐ huan. Everyday verb for liking food, rooms, or people.

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huí tóu. Appears in the friendly farewell 回头见！ ('See you soon!').

examples.text: 我先去送热茶，我们回头聊！
examples.trans: Let me deliver this hot tea first—we will talk soon!

examples.text: 今天辛苦了，回头见！
examples.trans: Great work today—see you soon!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yīn wèi. Introduces a reason; often paired with 所以 ('therefore') in the next clause.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

meanings.note: Outside one's home country.

examples.text: 他女儿目前跟着家人在国外读书。
examples.trans: His daughter is currently studying abroad with family.

examples.text: 这档节目专门去国外几个城市取景拍摄。
examples.trans: This show filmed on location across several cities abroad.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò. Means both 'sit down' (请坐) and 'ride inside a vehicle' (坐火车 'take the train').

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 您先坐下，别着急，我们马上看行李牌。
examples.trans: Please sit down first and do not worry; we will check the luggage tag right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mò shuǐ. Liquid writing ink for fountain pens. Measure word: 瓶 (píng, 'bottle').

examples.text: 这页旧信是用深蓝色墨水写的。
examples.trans: This old letter page was written in dark blue ink.

examples.text: 桌上的钢笔没墨水了，我得去加一点。
examples.trans: The fountain pen on the desk is out of ink; I need to refill it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bèi zhù. Combines 备 ('for reference') + 注 ('note/annotation') in ledgers, forms, or margins.

examples.text: 姑姑在登记本下面写了一行清楚的备注。
examples.trans: My aunt wrote a clear note at the bottom of the guest book.

examples.text: 请在订单备注里写明不要放糖。
examples.trans: Please write 'no sugar' in the order notes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个夏天 ('a summer').

examples.text: 房东律师寄来的？奇怪——我们房租一直交到明年夏天了。
examples.trans: Sent by the landlord's lawyer? Strange—our rent is paid right through next summer.

examples.text: 夏天坐在大树底下乘凉最舒服。
examples.trans: Sitting in the shade beneath the big tree in summer is bliss.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà shēng. Combines 大 ('big/loud') + 声 ('voice/sound'); modifies verbs of speaking or reading directly (大声念 'read aloud').

examples.text: 小晴，把木牌上的字大声念给我听听吧。
examples.trans: Qing, read the words on the wooden sign aloud for me to hear.

examples.text: 周经理在院子里大声宣布九号房咖啡角正式通过了审核。
examples.trans: In the courtyard, Manager Zhou announced aloud that the Room Nine café corner had officially passed the review.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo. Main adjective 'good'; as a result complement after a verb, means 'ready/completed properly' (修好, 准备好).

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rú guǒ. Standard conditional conjunction ('if'), often paired with 就 in the main clause.

examples.text: 如果你同意，我想把这首曲子补写完整。
examples.trans: If you agree, I would like to finish writing this piece of music.

examples.text: 如果明天不下雨，我们就把桌子搬到院子里。
examples.trans: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we will move the tables out into the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个字 ('a written character').

examples.text: 真好奇！那张行李牌上的字看着很眼熟。
examples.trans: How curious! The handwriting on that tag looked very familiar.

examples.text: 先别对外面透露一个字！让两兄弟先过完这个星期五下午！
examples.trans: Not a single word to anyone outside yet! Let the two brothers have their Friday afternoon first!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dìng. Used for setting a time or booking an appointment (定好 'settle/fix').

examples.text: 定好闹钟吧，老陈。明早我们跑赢冷水！
examples.trans: Set your alarm, Chen. Tomorrow morning we outrun the cold water!

examples.text: 我们已经定好了明天见面的时间。
examples.trans: We have already set the time to meet tomorrow.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jì. Used for mailing letters, postcards, or parcels.

examples.text: 从那天起我们就再没说过话。上周我给他寄了一张明信片。
examples.trans: Since that day we have not spoken again. Last week I mailed him a postcard.

examples.text: 房东律师寄来的？奇怪——我们房租一直交到明年夏天了。
examples.trans: Sent by the landlord's lawyer? Strange—our rent is paid right through next summer.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng. Counts sealed letters and mail items (一封信 'a letter').

examples.text: 我在看天气，小美！铃铛旁边这封厚信是谁放的？
examples.trans: I am checking the weather, Mei! Who put this thick letter beside the bell?

examples.text: 太好了……趁着等他们，我扫一眼这封房东来信。
examples.trans: Wonderful... while we wait, let me glance at this letter from the landlord.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo. Everyday adjective for small size; also prefixes younger colleagues' names warmly (小晴, 小美).

examples.text: 早上好，姑娘。我有一个宋名下的预订。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I have a booking for Song.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo yuàn. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座小院 ('a small courtyard').

examples.text: 有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
examples.trans: Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!

examples.text: 产权转让通知：八号小院整栋建筑将作为商业办公楼出售。
examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ jīng. Often pairs with sentence-final 了 (已经到了 'has already arrived').

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

examples.text: 还好烤箱里的面团已经放进去了。
examples.trans: My dough is already in the oven, at least.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gān jìng. Note first tone gān ('dry/clean'), never fourth tone.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dǐ xia. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最底下 ('the bottom').

examples.text: 看车轮底下——铅笔写的你和我的名字还在那儿。
examples.trans: Look underneath the wheels—your name and mine in pencil are still right there.

examples.text: 前面锁扣有个小锁孔，再看底下贴着：一把旧铜钥匙！
examples.trans: There is a tiny keyhole on the front latch, and taped underneath: an old brass key!

张.gloss: measure word for flat surfaces and paper

meanings.en: measure word for flat surfaces and paper
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhāng. Counts tables, beds, paper sheets, tickets, receipts, and luggage tags (一张桌子, 一张纸).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

meanings.note: Time noun dāngnián ('in bygone years, back then').

examples.text: 当年他离开卫视时得罪了不少人。
examples.trans: Back when he left the network, he offended many people.

examples.text: 她想起当年刚进大学时的梦想。
examples.trans: She recalled her dreams from her freshman days.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. As an adjective/adverb, 'fast/quickly'; in 快…了, 'about to'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: niàn. Used for reading a letter or notice out loud (念第一行 'read the first line aloud').

examples.text: 二十毫米、铜的、热水器阀门——我一路念过去！
examples.trans: Twenty millimetres, brass, water-heater valve—I will repeat it all the way!

examples.text: 十九条理由？！您是迎接哥哥，还是念火车时刻表呀？
examples.trans: Nineteen reasons?! Are you welcoming your brother or reading a train timetable?

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ men. First-person plural pronoun; add 的 for 'our' (我们的).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房 ('a room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhé. Used for folding chairs, blueprints, or paper.

examples.text: 等等，换房间我们给他打多少折？
examples.trans: Wait—what discount do we offer him for changing rooms?

examples.text: 快把那张纸折起来，塞进口袋里。
examples.trans: Fold up that sheet of paper right now and tuck it into your pocket.

meanings.note: Pinyin: guà. Used for hanging keys, coats, lanterns, or hanging up a phone.

examples.text: 这面圆镜子挂哪儿？窗户左边还是右边？
examples.trans: Where should I hang this round mirror? Left of the window or right?

examples.text: 挂在书桌右边吧，那里光线好。
examples.trans: Hang it to the right of the desk, where the light is good.

掀开.gloss: lift open; fold back (a flap, lid, or cloth)

meanings.en: lift open; fold back (a flap, lid, or cloth)
meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān kāi. Resultative verb joining 掀 ('lift a cover or corner') + 开 ('open').

examples.text: 先掀开左边蜡布，再掀开右边，里面的红金铁盒就露出来了！
examples.trans: Fold back the left flap of waxed cloth, then the right, and out gleams the red-and-gold tin box!

examples.text: 小美轻轻掀开蒸笼盖子，热腾腾的甜香飘满厨房。
examples.trans: Mei gently lifted the steamer lid, filling the kitchen with warm sweet fragrance.

meanings.note: Pronounced jiàoshòu; placed after a surname when used as a form of address (e.g., 方教授 'Professor Fang').
Pronounced jiàoshòu (or jiāoshòu in older usage) as a formal transitive verb meaning 'to impart knowledge or skills'.

examples.text: 我想问一下，方教授在哪办公啊？
examples.trans: May I ask where Professor Fang has his office?

examples.text: 小谷同学，先来认识一下学位评委的各位教授。
examples.trans: Xiaogu, come meet the professors on the degree committee first.

meanings.en: throw wide open; leave wide open
meanings.note: Pinyin: chǎng kāi. Describes gates or windows opened wide.

examples.text: 敬好邻居、热面包，还有敞开的大门！
examples.trans: To good neighbours, warm bread, and wide-open gates!

examples.text: 每天早上八点，小院木门准时敞开。
examples.trans: Every morning at eight, the wooden courtyard gates swing wide open.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí hou. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 这个时候 ('this moment').

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng xìn piàn. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张明信片 ('a postcard').

examples.text: 从那天起我们就再没说过话。上周我给他寄了一张明信片。
examples.trans: Since that day we have not spoken again. Last week I mailed him a postcard.

examples.text: 看，已经十二点零四分了。也许他把明信片扔进垃圾桶了。
examples.trans: Look, it is twelve-oh-four already. Maybe he tossed the postcard into the bin.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng. Measure word (量词): 颗 (kē), e.g. 一颗星 ('a star').

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

examples.text: 晴朗的夜空能看见很多星。
examples.trans: On a clear night sky you can see many stars.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个星期 ('a week').

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 脑子转得快，小晴。志豪每星期都读城市建筑规定。
examples.trans: Quick thinking, Qing. Hao reads city building rules every single week.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīng qī liù. Literally 'week-day six'; Mainland standard alongside informal 周六 (zhōu liù).

examples.text: 每个星期六早上，这条老街都有热闹的集市。
examples.trans: Every Saturday morning, this old street hosts a lively market.

examples.text: 星期六下午来院子里喝杯热柠檬茶吧。
examples.trans: Come to the courtyard for a cup of hot lemon tea on Saturday afternoon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Links two nouns (我是小晴); do NOT use simple 是 before plain adjectives like 好 or 忙.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuì. Superlative adverb placed before adjectives or feeling verbs (最好 'best', 最喜欢 'like best').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 最上面架子上金色包装那包。怎么了？
examples.trans: The gold-wrapped packet on the top shelf. Why?

meanings.note: Pinyin: péng you. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个朋友 ('a friend').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 今天有两位老朋友从外地来看我。
examples.trans: Two old friends are visiting me from out of town today.

examples.text: 朋友们，大家好。
examples.trans: Hello, friends.

examples.text: 我的朋友们来了。
examples.trans: My friends have come.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xìng rén. Combines 杏 ('apricot/almond') + 仁 ('nut kernel').

examples.text: 小美端来了一盘刚出炉的温热杏仁饼干。
examples.trans: Mei brought over a plate of warm almond biscuits fresh from the oven.

examples.text: 用杏仁粉做的柠檬挞底吃起来特别香酥。
examples.trans: A lemon tart crust made with ground almonds tastes wonderfully crisp and nutty.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lái. Movement toward the speaker, as main verb or directional complement (进来 'come in').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

meanings.note: Pinyin: měi. Usually followed by a measure word (每个星期 'every week', 每位客人 'every guest').

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiāo xi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个好消息 ('a piece of good news').

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

examples.text: 坏消息。老热水器上的铜压力阀门裂了。
examples.trans: Bad news. The brass pressure valve on the old water heater cracked.

related.gloss: a piece of good news (measure word 个)

meanings.note: Pinyin: dēng long. Measure word (量词): 盏 (zhǎn), e.g. 一盏灯笼 ('a lantern').

examples.text: 老陈，你在为中午挂纸灯笼吗？
examples.trans: Chen, are you hanging those paper lanterns for noon?

examples.text: 抬头看夜空下那些金色灯笼——真宁静啊！
examples.trans: Look up at those golden lanterns against the night sky—how peaceful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòng. Works as main verb ('use a key') or preposition ('with/using').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

留意.gloss: pay close attention, keep an eye out

meanings.en: pay close attention, keep an eye out
meanings.note: Verb-object liúyì ('observe attentively').

examples.text: 你留意观察整个立项推进的过程。
examples.trans: Keep an attentive eye on the whole greenlighting process.

examples.text: 上下舞台台阶有点滑，请各位嘉宾多留意脚下。
examples.trans: Stage steps are slick, so guests please watch your step.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎi yè chuāng. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇百叶窗 ('a louvered shutter').

examples.text: 因为湿木头百叶窗会柔化石板路传回来的回声……
examples.trans: Because wet wooden shutters soften the echo bouncing off the flagstones...

examples.text: 午后把木百叶窗放下一半，屋里既凉快又柔和。
examples.trans: Lowering the wooden shutters halfway at noon keeps the room cool and soft.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn. Exclamatory adverb before adjectives (真好！ 'How nice!') or adjective 'genuine'.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

examples.text: 真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
examples.trans: How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǒng. Read zhǒng as a measure word for kinds/types (这种, 那种); read zhòng as the verb 'plant/grow'.

examples.text: 老陈，这些香草是你自己种的吗？
examples.trans: Chen, did you grow these herbs yourself?

examples.text: 老房子连着旧回忆——那种争吵最伤人。
examples.trans: Old houses are tied to old memories—arguments like that cut deepest.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì. Placed before any number to turn it into an ordinal (第一 'first', 第二天 'the second day').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng. Everyday verb for waiting (等一下 'wait a moment').

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 等一下，小晴……你拿了哪一包黄油？
examples.trans: Wait a second, Qing... which packet of butter did you grab?

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng deng. Urgent or casual reduplication of 等 ('wait!').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: suànhuà.

examples.text: 他是个说话算话的人。
examples.trans: He is a man of his word.

examples.text: 你答应过我的事情一定要算话。
examples.trans: You must keep your word regarding what you promised me.

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǐbái.

examples.text: 她穿了一件米白的毛衣。
examples.trans: She wore an off-white sweater.

examples.text: 墙壁被粉刷成了米白色。
examples.trans: The walls were painted off-white.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hóng. Describes the color red; note that 红茶 is what English calls 'black tea'.

examples.text: 告诉他们，我箱子上面口袋里有红丝带！
examples.trans: Tell them there is a red ribbon inside the top pocket of my case!

examples.text: 我的行李箱！快打开上面口袋……对，红丝带！
examples.trans: My suitcase! Let me open the top pocket... yes, the red ribbon!

meanings.note: Verb/noun yuēdìng ('agreed terms; arrange').

examples.text: 约定之外的制作项目我们实在没法兼顾。
examples.trans: We cannot juggle extra projects beyond what was agreed.

examples.text: 大家按照事先的约定准时在茶馆见面。
examples.trans: Everyone met promptly at the teahouse as agreed.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gěi. As main verb, 'give'; as preposition/complement, marks the recipient (给你 'for/to you', 递给我 'pass to me').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǜ sè. Measure word (量词): 种 (zhǒng), e.g. 一种绿色 ('a shade of green').

examples.text: 小美，帮我把这些绿色的大书放到椅子上。
examples.trans: Mei, help me put these big green books on the chair.

examples.text: 她穿了一件绿色的外套。
examples.trans: She is wearing a green coat.

related.gloss: a shade of green (measure word 种)

meanings.note: Pinyin: měihǎo.

examples.text: 童年的记忆总是美好的。
examples.trans: Childhood memories are always beautiful.

examples.text: 祝你有一个美好的未来。
examples.trans: I wish you a bright and beautiful future.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nàixīn.

examples.text: 教小孩子需要很大的耐心。
examples.trans: Teaching young children requires a lot of patience.

examples.text: 他渐渐失去了耐心。
examples.trans: He gradually lost his patience.

meanings.note: Pinyin: méi guǒ. Measure word (量词): 颗 (kē) or 篮 (lán). Joins 莓 ('berry') + 果 ('fruit').

examples.text: 小美在蛋糕顶上点缀了几颗新鲜的红莓果。
examples.trans: Mei garnished the top of the cake with a few fresh red berries.

examples.text: 这罐果酱是用后院刚摘的野莓果熬制的。
examples.trans: This jar of jam was simmered from wild berries just picked in the backyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dàn gāo. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块蛋糕 ('a piece of cake').

examples.text: 他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
examples.trans: His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with a dusting of powdered sugar on top!

examples.text: 十一点二十分。小美，蛋糕好了吗？
examples.trans: Eleven twenty. Mei, is the cake ready?

related.gloss: a piece of cake (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: xíng. Read xíng when meaning 'that works / okay' (不行 'won't work'); read háng when counting lines of text (第一行).

examples.text: 等等，咸黄油配果酱不行，做炒蛋却棒极了！
examples.trans: Wait—salted butter fails with jam, yet for scrambled eggs it is amazing!

examples.text: 小晴，替我念第一行。快说是我眼镜又看花眼了！
examples.trans: Qing, read the top line for me. Tell me my glasses are playing tricks on my eyes!

meanings.en: neighbors; folks on the same street
meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē fang. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位街坊 ('a neighborhood resident').

examples.text: 超过八十年的小院建筑，只要一楼每天服务街坊邻居，禁止改成私人办公室。
examples.trans: Any courtyard building over eighty years old may not become private offices as long as the ground floor serves neighbours daily.

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Appears in farewells (再见, 明天见) and as result complement of perception (看见, 听见).

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

examples.text: 老陈，听得见吗？我刚经过绿药店！
examples.trans: Chen, can you hear me? I just passed the green pharmacy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuō huà. Separable verb-object compound ('speak words').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 从那天起我们就再没说过话。上周我给他寄了一张明信片。
examples.trans: Since that day we have not spoken again. Last week I mailed him a postcard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐng. At the start of a request, means 'please' (请进, 请坐, 请问); before a person, 'invite / treat'.

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒu lù. Separable verb-object compound 走 ('walk') + 路 ('road'); placed before 去 + place to mean 'walk to…'.

examples.text: 星期六集市离客栈很近，我们走路去只要五分钟。
examples.trans: The Saturday market is right near the inn—it only takes us five minutes to walk there.

examples.text: 吃过晚饭去河边走走路，浑身都舒服。
examples.trans: Taking a walk by the river after dinner makes you feel great all over.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐ. Used for rising or lifting upward (抱起 'pick up in arms').

examples.text: 老陈，抱起那些纸箱，我们下楼吧！
examples.trans: Chen, pick up those cardboard boxes—down the stairs we go!

examples.text: 从那天起我们就再没说过话。上周我给他寄了一张明信片。
examples.trans: Since that day we have not spoken again. Last week I mailed him a postcard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng qīng. Reduplication of 轻 ('light/soft'), used directly before short verbs or with 地 (轻轻地抽出来).

examples.text: 宋老师用两根手指把旧乐谱轻轻抽了出来。
examples.trans: Teacher Song gently slid the old music sheet out with two fingers.

examples.text: 怕吵醒午睡的客人，小晴轻轻关上了木门。
examples.trans: So as not to wake guests napping at noon, Qing closed the wooden door softly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái shi. Joins choices in questions (茶还是咖啡？ 'tea or coffee?') or means 'still'.

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 宋老师早！您想喝咖啡还是红茶？
examples.trans: Morning, Teacher Song! Would you like coffee or black tea?

meanings.en: and also; in addition; still have
meanings.note: Pinyin: hái yǒu. Adds another item to a list ('plus…').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà me. Opens a conclusion drawn from what was just said (那么，门在哪儿？ 'So where is the door?'); before an adjective it means 'that (much)'.

examples.text: 那么，那些旧书后面有第九扇门！
examples.trans: So behind those old books, there's a ninth door!

examples.text: 那么小美的咖啡馆和宋老师的钢琴，不会吵醒楼上的客人吧？
examples.trans: So Mei's café and Teacher Song's piano won't wake the guests upstairs?

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōu. Summarizes everything BEFORE it and always stands directly before the verb/adjective (我们都喜欢).

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ miàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 箱子里面 ('inside the suitcase').

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: chángyǐ. Measure word: 张, 把.

examples.text: 公园里有几张木制的长椅。
examples.trans: There are several wooden benches in the park.

examples.text: 他们坐在长椅上聊天。
examples.trans: They sat on the bench chatting.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yángtái. Measure word: 个.

examples.text: 我喜欢坐在阳台上喝茶。
examples.trans: I like sitting on the balcony drinking tea.

examples.text: 阳台上种满了很多绿植。
examples.trans: The balcony is full of green plants.
